name: Meteors & Eclipses
description: The meteor showers and eclipses coming up, with the Moon's interference worked out for your place: each shower's peak night, expected rate, best hour, how high its radiant climbs, and how much moonlight there is. Lunar eclipses are checked against your horizon and solar eclipses against your continent. Everything is computed from a bundled table, so it needs no network.

cell_options.name: location
cell_options.label: Place
cell_options.help: Where the sky is watched from. Sets how high each radiant climbs, whether the Moon is up, and which eclipses are visible. Falls back to the app-level location in Settings when empty.

cell_options.name: layout
cell_options.label: Layout
cell_options.help: Timeline draws the coming months on one rule with a glyph per event. Next event is one shower or eclipse large, with the three after it as lines.

cell_options.name: months
cell_options.label: How many months
cell_options.help: How far the timeline runs, starting from the first of this month.

cell_options.name: show_eclipses
cell_options.label: Eclipses
cell_options.help: Solar and lunar eclipses alongside the showers.

cell_options.name: only_visible
cell_options.label: Only what is visible from here
cell_options.help: Hides showers whose radiant never rises at this place, lunar eclipses with the Moon below the horizon, and solar eclipses that miss this continent.

cell_options.name: title
cell_options.label: Title
cell_options.help: The heading. Leave empty to hide it.
